test_policy.notes: CSU does not require SAT/ACT. The admissions site says submitted scores are reviewed only if the applicant emails a request, are not given much weight, and are not used to decline an application or in scholarship decisions; the Common Data Set answers 'No' to using SAT/ACT in admission.

requirements.notes: International freshmen apply with the Common App: 250-650 word essay, most recent transcripts (certified English translation if needed), passport copy and financial-support documents for the I-20. The $65 fee is the international freshman fee (the Common Data Set lists $50 generally). Review is holistic; students with a 3.0+ GPA and a steady or upward trend are generally admitted. Recommendation letters and interview are not mentioned on the page.

deadlines.label: Early action (non-binding), fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Complete file by Nov. 15 for full consideration and automatic scholarship review by Jan. 15. The page gives dates without a year, so the current cycle is assumed. Common Data Set: priority date Nov. 15, closing date July 31, rolling notification from Oct. 1.

deadlines.label: Regular decision, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Full consideration by Jan. 15, scholarship review by Feb. 28; applications are then reviewed on a rolling basis until mid-summer but scholarships may not be available. The page prints no year.

deadlines.label: International scholarships: highest consideration
deadlines.notes: Dec. 15 is highest consideration and Mar. 15 regular consideration; no separate scholarship application. The page prints no year.

english_policy.waiver_notes: No test needed with SAT EBRW 520+, ACT English/Reading 20+, IB HL English 5+, AP English Language or Literature 4+, IGCSE/A-level English C or better (official, not predicted), WAEC/WASSCE English B3+, or Gaokao English 105+ plus an online interview. Exempt if English is the first language and the applicant is from Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand or the UK. Conditional admission: applicants who meet academic standards but lack a qualifying score enroll in CSU's Intensive English Program (most finish in 1-2 semesters; IEP courses carry no degree credit), then move into degree courses; send evidence by June 1 (fall) or Nov. 15 (spring).

english.notes: Exams before Jan. 2026. Paper-based TOEFL considered case by case. No subscore minimum listed.
Exams after Jan. 2026; CSU accepts both score types. The page does not name the 1-6 scale.

aid.notes: All admitted international undergraduates are automatically considered for scholarships of $2,000-$12,000 per year, renewable up to four years with good academic standing; no separate application. CSU says no institutional scholarship covers the full cost of attendance. Federal aid is limited to U.S. citizens and permanent residents. The Common Data Set checks both need-based and non-need-based institutional aid for nonresidents, but the aid pages do not describe need-based aid for international students, so need-based aid for international students is not yet confirmed.

ielts.note: No institution code is listed; the documents page says IELTS results can be uploaded as a PDF in the Admissions Dashboard.

duolingo.note: No institution code is listed on the documents page.

pte.note: PTE is not listed for undergraduate English proficiency.

tier_notes.engineering: Our estimate: R1 research university with a broad engineering college; placed in the 41-100 band, not based on a published ranking.
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Our estimate: large life, agricultural and environmental science programs at an R1 university; placed in the 41-100 band, not based on a published ranking.
